label: CM-3(1)
title: Automated Documentation, Notification, and Prohibition of Changes

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Document proposed changes to the system;

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Notify {{ insert: param, cm-03.01_odp.02 }} of proposed changes to the system and request change approval;

children.label: (c)
children.prose: Highlight proposed changes to the system that have not been approved or disapproved within {{ insert: param, cm-03.01_odp.03 }};

children.label: (d)
children.prose: Prohibit changes to the system until designated approvals are received;

children.label: (e)
children.prose: Document all changes to the system; and

children.label: (f)
children.prose: Notify {{ insert: param, cm-03.01_odp.04 }} when approved changes to the system are completed.

params.label: automated mechanisms
guidelines: mechanisms used to automate configuration change control are defined;

params.label: approval authorities
guidelines: approval authorities to be notified of and request approval for proposed changes to the system are defined;

params.label: time period
guidelines: the time period after which to highlight changes that have not been approved or disapproved is defined;

params.label: personnel
guidelines: personnel to be notified when approved changes are complete is/are defined;
